decision.question: Should this product target freelancers first?
decision.answer: There is not enough independent evidence to choose freelancers over other segments.

knowns: The product automates a repeated workflow.
assumptions: Freelancers may feel the workflow pain.
unknowns: Problem frequency, buyer, willingness to pay, and reachable channel.

tickets.title: Collect independent evidence from candidate users
tickets.evidence_needed: Two independent sources or interviews about the same workflow problem.
acceptance_criteria: Compare at least two candidate segments.
Record the source and date for each material fact.
Return a ranked recommendation or keep the status insufficient.

artifacts.title: Unresolved first segment
artifacts.summary: Freelancers are a hypothesis that needs validation.

claims.claim: Freelancers are the best first audience.

evidence.excerpt: One person says the workflow takes too much time.

next_actions: Interview or survey users from at least two candidate segments.
human_decisions: Choose the segment access plan for the next research run.
